atlassian.description: Atlassian MCP server — exposes Confluence pages and Jira issues as MCP tools. Install: pip install uv then uvx mcp-atlassian. Source: https://github.com/sooperset/mcp-atlassian

github.description: Official GitHub MCP server — search repos, read files, manage issues/PRs. Install: npx handles it automatically. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/github

gitlab.description: Official GitLab MCP server — manage repos, wikis, milestones, MRs. Install: npx handles it automatically. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/gitlab

playwright.description: Playwright MCP server — browser automation and UI testing. Install: npx handles it automatically. Source: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp

selenium.description: Selenium Grid MCP server — cross-browser automation. Download jar from: https://github.com/SeleniumHQ/selenium/releases
